spec:
  otel:
    semconv: 1.27.0
    resource_attributes:
      required:
        - service.name
        - service.namespace
        - service.version
        - deployment.environment
      custom:
        - kafka.cluster.id
        - kafka.broker.id
    sdk:
      languages:
        - java
        - go
        - node
      sampling:
        policy: parentbased_traceidratio
        ratio: 0.1
      propagators:
        - tracecontext
        - baggage
      log_correlation: true
  telemetry:
    backends:
      - id: metrics-prom
        signal: metrics
        product: prometheus
        version:
          declared: "3.14"
          min: "2.53"
          gating: warn
        endpoints:
          - http://prometheus:9090
        default: true
      - id: logs-loki
        signal: logs
        product: loki
        version:
          declared: "3.7"
          min: "3.0"
          gating: warn
        endpoints:
          - http://loki:3100
        default: true
      - id: traces-tempo
        signal: traces
        product: tempo
        version:
          declared: "2.10"
          min: "2.5"
          gating: warn
        endpoints:
          - http://tempo:3200
        default: true
  environments:
    prod:
      criticality: tier-2
      backends:
        metrics: metrics-prom
        logs: logs-loki
        traces: traces-tempo
  slis:
    - id: kafka_broker_availability
      type: ratio
      description: Fraction of brokers reporting ready vs. the cluster's declared broker count.
      semconv_metric: kafka.broker.up
      good: sum(up{job="kafka-broker"} == bool 1)
      total: count(up{job="kafka-broker"})
    - id: kafka_consumer_group_lag_seconds
      type: threshold
      description: Maximum consumer-group lag in seconds equivalent, per consumer group (message-count lag over the group's rolling consumption rate).
      semconv_metric: messaging.kafka.consumer.lag
      query: |
        max by (consumergroup) (
          kafka_consumergroup_lag /
            (rate(kafka_consumergroup_current_offset[5m]) > 0)
        )
      threshold: 60
      unit: seconds
    - id: kafka_partition_replica_health
      type: ratio
      description: Fraction of partitions whose in-sync replica count equals their replica count (== bool, one per healthy partition).
      semconv_metric: kafka.partition.in_sync_replicas
      good: sum(kafka_topic_partition_in_sync_replica == bool kafka_topic_partition_replicas)
      total: count(kafka_topic_partition_replicas)
    - id: kafka_produce_latency_p99
      type: threshold
      description: 99th-percentile total time of Produce requests on the broker, in seconds (queue, local, replication wait, response send) — what a producer waits for an ack.
      semconv_metric: kafka.broker.request.latency
      query: max(kafka_network_requestmetrics_totaltimems{request="Produce",quantile="0.99"}) / 1000
      threshold: 0.1
      unit: seconds
    - id: kafka_fetch_latency_p99
      type: threshold
      description: 99th-percentile local (broker processing) time of FetchConsumer requests, in seconds.
      semconv_metric: kafka.broker.request.latency
      query: max(kafka_network_requestmetrics_localtimems{request="FetchConsumer",quantile="0.99"}) / 1000
      threshold: 0.05
      unit: seconds
    - id: http_service_availability
      type: ratio
      description: Fraction of HTTP requests not answered with a 5xx status, from the request-duration histogram's _count series (semconv http.server.request.duration, label http_response_status_code).
      semconv_metric: http.server.request.duration
      good: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="orders-api",http_response_status_code!~"5.."}[5m]))
      total: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="orders-api"}[5m]))
    - id: http_service_latency_p99
      type: threshold
      description: 99th-percentile server-side request duration in seconds, from the semconv http.server.request.duration histogram.
      semconv_metric: http.server.request.duration
      query: |
        histogram_quantile(0.99,
          sum by (le)(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="orders-api"}[5m])))
      threshold: 0.5
      unit: seconds
  slos:
    - id: kafka_broker_availability_99_9
      sli: kafka_broker_availability
      objective: 0.999
      window: 30d
      error_budget_policy: ref:platform/std-budget-policy
    - id: kafka_consumer_group_lag_seconds_99
      sli: kafka_consumer_group_lag_seconds
      objective: 0.99
      window: 7d
      error_budget_policy: ref:platform/std-budget-policy
    - id: kafka_partition_replica_health_99_95
      sli: kafka_partition_replica_health
      objective: 0.9995
      window: 30d
      error_budget_policy: ref:platform/std-budget-policy
    - id: kafka_produce_latency_p99_99
      sli: kafka_produce_latency_p99
      objective: 0.99
      window: 30d
      error_budget_policy: ref:platform/std-budget-policy
    - id: kafka_fetch_latency_p99_99
      sli: kafka_fetch_latency_p99
      objective: 0.99
      window: 30d
      error_budget_policy: ref:platform/std-budget-policy
    - id: http_service_availability_99_5
      sli: http_service_availability
      objective: 0.995
      window: 30d
      error_budget_policy: ref:platform/std-budget-policy
    - id: http_service_latency_p99_99
      sli: http_service_latency_p99
      objective: 0.99
      window: 30d
      error_budget_policy: ref:platform/std-budget-policy
  pipelines:
    receivers:
      - name: otlp
        protocols:
          - grpc
          - http
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      - name: prometheus
        scrape_configs:
          - job_name: kafka-broker
            scrape_interval: 30s
            static_configs:
              -
                targets:
                  - kafka-broker.kafka:9404
          - job_name: kafka-exporter
            scrape_interval: 30s
            static_configs:
              -
                targets:
                  - kafka-exporter.kafka:9308
    processors:
      - name: memory_limiter
        limit_percentage: 80
      - name: batch
        timeout: 10s
      - name: resource
        attributes:
          - key: deployment.environment
            value: prod
            action: upsert
    exporters:
      metrics:
        kind: prometheusremotewrite
        endpoint: http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/write
        external_labels:
          service: orders-api
      logs:
        kind: otlphttp
        endpoints:
          - http://loki:3100/otlp
      traces:
        kind: otlp
        endpoint: tempo:4317
  storage:
    metrics:
      backend: prometheus
      version: "3.14"
      retention: 90d
      remote_write:
        - url: http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/write
    logs:
      backend: loki
      version: "3.7"
      retention: 30d
    traces:
      backend: tempo
      version: "2.10"
      retention: 7d
      sampling: head-based
  queries:
    recording_rules:
      - name: orders_api:kafka_broker_availability:ratio_5m
        expr: ref:slis.kafka_broker_availability
        interval: 30s
      - name: orders_api:kafka_consumer_group_lag_seconds:value_5m
        expr: ref:slis.kafka_consumer_group_lag_seconds
        interval: 30s
      - name: orders_api:kafka_partition_replica_health:ratio_5m
        expr: ref:slis.kafka_partition_replica_health
        interval: 30s
      - name: orders_api:kafka_produce_latency_p99:value_5m
        expr: ref:slis.kafka_produce_latency_p99
        interval: 30s
      - name: orders_api:kafka_fetch_latency_p99:value_5m
        expr: ref:slis.kafka_fetch_latency_p99
        interval: 30s
      - name: orders_api:http_service_availability:ratio_5m
        expr: ref:slis.http_service_availability
        interval: 30s
      - name: orders_api:http_service_latency_p99:value_5m
        expr: ref:slis.http_service_latency_p99
        interval: 30s
    derived_views:
      - id: golden_signals_orders_api
        bind: ref:platform/golden-signals-view
        params:
          service: orders-api
      - id: kafka_per_topic_throughput
        bind: ref:platform/per-resource-rollup
        params:
          metric: kafka_server_brokertopicmetrics_messagesin_total{topic!=""}
          by:
            - topic
      - id: kafka_per_consumergroup_lag
        bind: ref:platform/per-resource-rollup
        params:
          sli: kafka_consumer_group_lag_seconds
          by:
            - consumergroup
      - id: http_service_per_route_latency
        bind: ref:platform/per-resource-rollup
        params:
          sli: http_service_latency_p99
          by:
            - http_route
      - id: http_service_per_route_traffic
        bind: ref:platform/per-resource-rollup
        params:
          metric: http_server_request_duration_seconds_count
          by:
            - http_route
            - http_request_method
  dashboards:
    - id: orders-api-overview
      provider:
        kind: grafana
        version: "12.4"
        schemaVersion: 41
      folder: orders-api
      source: file://dashboards/orders-api-overview.json
      panel_bindings:
        - panel: slis-kafka-broker-availability
          binds_to: slis.kafka_broker_availability
        - panel: slis-kafka-consumer-group-lag-seconds
          binds_to: slis.kafka_consumer_group_lag_seconds
        - panel: slis-kafka-partition-replica-health
          binds_to: slis.kafka_partition_replica_health
        - panel: slis-kafka-produce-latency-p99
          binds_to: slis.kafka_produce_latency_p99
        - panel: slis-kafka-fetch-latency-p99
          binds_to: slis.kafka_fetch_latency_p99
        - panel: slis-http-service-availability
          binds_to: slis.http_service_availability
        - panel: slis-http-service-latency-p99
          binds_to: slis.http_service_latency_p99
        - panel: slos-kafka-broker-availability-99-9

        expected_mttd: 2m

clauses.description: At least one availability SLO (ratio-type SLI).
At least one latency SLO (threshold or distribution SLI).
A third, domain-specific SLO beyond availability and latency (4+ SLOs total).
Every declared SLI is referenced by at least one SLO.
OTel Collector pipeline declares an `otlp` receiver.
`service.name` listed in otel.resource_attributes.required.
OTel SemConv version >= 1.26.0 (binding floor).
OTel SemConv at currently-tracked version (1.27.0).
At least five required resource attributes declared.
`otel.sdk.log_correlation: true` (trace IDs injected into logs).
Pipelines export metrics.
Pipelines export logs and traces.
Pipelines include a tail_sampling processor.
spec.telemetry.backends covers metrics + logs + traces.
tier-1 backends pin a `min` version with `gating: enforce`.
Every extended surface references a declared telemetry backend or explicit external ref.
Every SLO has at least one recording rule materialising its SLI.
At least one derived view (e.g. golden signals or per-tenant rollup).
At least one dashboard declared (service overview).
A second dashboard (SLO burn) on top of service overview.
Service overview + SLO burn + deployment overlay + customer impact (4+ dashboards).
Every SLO has at least one burn-rate alert with multi-window policy.
At least one forecast declared on a primary availability SLO.
SEV1 route includes a voice channel.
At least one self-healing remediation declared.
Regression gate set to a release-blocking mode.
At least one synthetic check declared.
Every SLO is the steady-state hypothesis of at least one chaos experiment.
At least one chaos experiment scheduled monthly+ in staging.
At least one chaos experiment runs weekly+ in production with OTel-instrumented synthetic probes.
